★Request
Display Still in Love (Summer Uniform)
Let us devour... even the moon itself.

And so, once more... my consciousness slips away. Even as everything fades into ambiguity...
I can feel it, clear as day. That inescapable presence... even now... still――

Reason screams out... "Stay away from 'that.'"
Yet drawn by something utterly irresistible――my instincts are violently pulled in.

Amidst my clouded consciousness, the same question always... always surfaces.
"If I had known this outcome back then... what would I have done?"

A single bead of cold sweat... drips down my back. That voice, so frail
I almost mistook it for my imagination, was in truth――the spark that unleashed a raging torrent.
Found you.

...What a lovely, dark night.
And yet, it's still... still so bright... Ah... aaah...
Um... excuse me...!
F o u n d   y o u u u u u............!!

Ahaha! Ahahahaha ha ha hahahahaha!!
AaAAAaaAAaahhhAAa............Ahahaha ha!!

Instinctively, I clutch my neck. Looking in the mirror reveals a red mark
that I have no recollection of getting. Staring at that mark, looking as though something had bitten me――
Um...

I'm Still.
...Still in Love――
Give me――everything you have.

A shriek steeped in ecstasy echoes across the void.
Her figure, appearing as if primal instinct itself had taken form and run wild――

It's just... well, I felt so terrible...
...Were you all right? ――Yesterday...

She is terrifying enough to freeze the blood.
And... beautiful enough to leave a burning scar.
...Ahaha.
Found you...

Waxen, pale skin that refuses to let even starlight pass through...
And glowing with an eerie, murky radiance――a pair of spine-chillingly crimson eyes.

That ferocious, untamed run that I couldn't banish from my mind...
That sheer, unadulterated display that might have made some frown in disapproval――

Suddenly, I realize I've quickened my pace. Even as an adult,
a deserted night street feels somewhat lonely, eerie... and frightening.

Aaah...!! ...I want to be filled...
More... and more... Yes... that's right――

...I wonder, knowing full well it is an exercise in futility.
Because... the answer is always the same.
Um...

C o m e　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　
　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　h e r e

Suddenly meeting those crimson eyes... The Umamusume standing before me,
looking fragile enough that a gentle breeze might blow her away... was undeniably that very same girl.

――The last thing I remember was those crimson eyes burning with ecstasy.
And the pain. A deep pain... as though my very soul had been reaped away.

...I-I am so sorry...
I didn't mean to startle you...

――Driven by an impulse, I had bolted out of my room.
My heart is pounding wildly... Was it out of fear, or was it...?

It happened that night... when I encountered primal instinct that knew no slumber.
Yes, that was on my way home after assisting with off-campus duties as a rookie trainer――

When I woke up, I was collapsed in the entryway. Drenched in cold sweat...
Was everything from last night merely a nightmare brought on by the sweltering heat?
Give me――everything you have.
――...Haa... haah... Aaah, aaah, aahh...!!

That summer.
That day, so muggy and suffocating it felt like it would rot the soul.

Where should I consider the true beginning? Even now, I no longer know.
Yet amidst my hazy memories, what I recall with overwhelming awe is――

I tremble with terror so intense I want to recoil. And yet, for some reason...
Step by step, my feet were carrying me... toward her.

Before I knew it, I was standing on an unfamiliar hilltop. What had
happened to me...? Before I could even think, my eyes were captivated――
